title: US Army selects edge-first software to maintain battlefield supply during jamming | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies received a $99 million military contract to deploy its AI-powered TyrOS logistics platform across Army units for improved battlefield supply chain management.
body_markdown:
Interesting Engineering covered Rune Technologies by Christopher McFadden in a piece titled “US Army selects edge-first software to maintain battlefield supply during jamming.” Rune Technologies received a $99 million military contract to deploy its AI-powered TyrOS logistics platform across Army units for improved battlefield supply chain management.


Read the full article[here](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/us-army-selects-edge-first-software) .
